retarded_subspace.primary_anchor: Dirian et al. arXiv:1403.6068 discussion around equations (2.8)-(2.9); Maggiore arXiv:1307.3898 discussion around equations (20)-(25)
retarded_subspace.result: The localized differential system admits arbitrary homogeneous solutions, but the original nonlocal theory does not promote them to independent propagating data. A definition of Box^-1 with the retarded prescription fixes the homogeneous solution/boundary conditions. Therefore the arbitrary six-direction homogeneous seeds used by C10.47 probe the enlarged localized ODE solution space rather than six physical free initial conditions of one fixed minimal retarded RT theory.
retarded_subspace.dimension_claim: No independent physical homogeneous-IC dimension is assigned beyond the explicit statement that these modes are fixed by the chosen nonlocal operator/boundary prescription.
